name.ja: Bトレインショーティー　スハ43系客車（茶）
name.en: B Train Shorty Suha 43 series passenger car (brown)

description.ja: • 落成時は茶色だったスハ43系客車は、のちに優等列車を青色に塗装変更したものの、動態保存車は茶色に塗りなおされ、イベント列車等で活躍。
description.en: • The SUHA 43 series passenger cars were brown when completed, but although the honor train was later painted blue, the dynamic preservation cars were repainted brown and used as event trains.

description.ja: • 往年のローカル列車には欠かせない車両。
description.en: • An indispensable vehicle for local trains of yesteryear.

description.ja: • スハ43形とスハフ42形（茶色）のセット。
description.en: • A set of Suha 43 type and Suhafu 42 type (brown).
